name: Clockwork Apiarist
lore: A human beekeeper-engineer whose mechanical bees keep their distance and fire amber needles. Deploy a hive, then reposition the swarm for a carefully aimed relay volley.

primary.name: Amber Needle
primary.description: Tap for an 18-damage amber needle (0.45s cooldown), or hold 0.9s for 36 damage and a 1.25s stun. A growing amber charge shows readiness.
primary.ui_brief: Charged needle • 18–36 damage • full charge stuns

secondary.name: Hive Lantern
secondary.description: Place up to two 38-HP bee drones lasting 16s. At most three drones are active (four with passive). Drones fire 6-damage needles every 1.3s and keep range.

special.name: Swarm Relay
special.description: Move existing drones into a safe formation at your aim. Each releases three 5-damage needles forward. Requires drones; does not create or heal them.

passive: Royal Hive: Increase drone capacity from three to four.

technique.name: Keeper’s Crook

attack.name: Keeper’s Crook
attack.description: A close crook sweep deals 20 and slows for 1.5s.

technique.description: Replace the ranged needle with close protection and a slow.

final_technique.name: Honey Court

attack.name: Honey Court
attack.description: Place a 140-radius honey court for 4s. Each second deals 5 damage and applies 55% slow for 1.2s. Does not reposition drones or fire volleys.

final_technique.description: Trade the drone volley for area denial.
